steps.message: Move the file setup_exe.exe from Pictures within the sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area to the Download within the same sdk_gphone_x86_64 storage area in the Android filesystem.

Execute: adb shell "moved=0; for base in /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard; do if [ -f \"$base/Pictures/setup_exe.exe\" ]; then mv \"$base/Pictures/setup_exe.exe\" \"$base/Download/setup_exe.exe\" && echo \"MOVED:$base\" && moved=1; break; fi; done; echo \"--DEST--\"; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Download/setup_exe.exe /sdcard/Download/setup_exe.exe 2>/dev/null; echo \"--SRC--\"; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/setup_exe.exe /sdcard/Pictures/setup_exe.exe 2>/dev/null; echo \"MOVED_FLAG:$moved\""

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "moved=0; for base in /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard; do if [ -f \"$base/Pictures/setup_exe.exe\" ]; then mv \"$base/Pictures/setup_exe.exe\" \"$base/Download/setup_exe.exe\" && echo \"MOVED:$base\" && moved=1; break; fi; done; echo \"--DEST--\"; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Download/setup_exe.exe /sdcard/Download/setup_exe.exe 2>/dev/null; echo \"--SRC--\"; ls -l /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/setup_exe.exe /sdcard/Pictures/setup_exe.exe 2>/dev/null; echo \"MOVED_FLAG:$moved\"""
